title: Lifting restricted-scalar section isomorphisms of completed affine coherent modules
statement: Let B be a Noetherian commutative ring [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring], I an ideal, and R its I-adic completion [def-weil-pbc-adic-completion]. Let A and D be coherent O_Spec(R)-modules [pqf-def-coherent]. Given any B-linear isomorphism e:Res_B^R Gamma(Spec R,A)\simeq Res_B^R Gamma(Spec R,D), where sections have the canonical R-actions [lem-weil-pbc-spec-module-tilde-sections], there exists a sheaf isomorphism a:A\simeq D whose map on sections restricted to B is exactly e.

source.place: Affine formal-module interpretation; explicit density argument from completion quotient kernels (05GG), finite-module completeness (031B and 00MA), and affine quasi-coherent equivalence (01I6)

proof.text: R is Noetherian. Reuse the existing private AlgebraicGeometry.finite_spec_sections from CoherentAffineMapSupportRadical, available through a proof-only import all, to obtain finite R-module target sections. That existing lemma applies coherent affine section finiteness and transports it along GammaSpec. Coherence on the Noetherian spectrum also gives quasi-coherence.

R is I-adically complete by Mathlib AdicCompletion.isAdicComplete. Transport this property along the algebra map using IsAdicComplete.map_algebraMap_iff. Finite target sections over R are complete for IR by the finite-module-completeness theorem, hence are Hausdorff for I as B-modules.

At each n choose the representative a of r.val n in B. AdicCompletion.pow_smul_top_eq_ker_eval shows r-algebraMap(a) lies in I^n times R. Submodule.smul_induction_on and the scalar-tower law show its action on any module lies in I^n times that module. The same induction shows every B-linear map preserves this filtration. Therefore f(r*x) and r*f(x) are both congruent to a*f(x) modulo I^n. IsHausdorff.eq_iff_smodEq proves equality. Upgrade e.hom to an R-linear map. Restriction of scalars reflects isomorphisms, so the upgraded map is invertible.

Use Mathlib tildeEquiv on the quasi-coherent objects A and D. Its inverse, the section functor, is fully faithful. Lift the R-linear section isomorphism by inverse.preimageIso, then apply the inclusion to sheaf modules. Functor.map_preimage gives exactly the original B-linear section map. This covers I=0 and I=B without an extra case.

lean.statement:
theorem completedAffine_coherent_iso_lift
    (B : Type u) [CommRing B] [IsNoetherianRing B] (I : Ideal B)
    (A D : CoherentModules (Spec (CommRingCat.of (AdicCompletion I B))))
    (e : (ModuleCat.restrictScalars (algebraMap B (AdicCompletion I B))).obj
        ((moduleSpecΓFunctor (R := CommRingCat.of (AdicCompletion I B))).obj A.obj) ≅
      (ModuleCat.restrictScalars (algebraMap B (AdicCompletion I B))).obj
        ((moduleSpecΓFunctor (R := CommRingCat.of (AdicCompletion I B))).obj D.obj)) :
    ∃ a : A.obj ≅ D.obj,
      (ModuleCat.restrictScalars (algebraMap B (AdicCompletion I B))).map
        ((moduleSpecΓFunctor (R := CommRingCat.of (AdicCompletion I B))).map a.hom) =
          e.hom
